templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum that layers terms for AI features onto an existing product agreement, covering input and output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific warranty disclaimers.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA business associate agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information handled on a covered entity's behalf.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling access to a hosted cloud service, covering subscription use rights, customer data, payment, warranties, indemnities, and limitation of liability.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR-oriented data processing agreement defining controller and processor roles, subprocessor use, security measures, international transfers, and breach notification.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-access design partnerships, covering pre-release product access, feedback obligations, confidentiality, and IP ownership of the resulting product.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
templates.description: Fill-in cover page for the Mutual NDA that captures the parties, purpose, confidentiality period, and governing law, and incorporates the standard terms by reference.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard terms of the mutual non-disclosure agreement, governing how each party discloses, protects, and returns the other's confidential information.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Commercial partnership terms covering each party's obligations, referral and revenue arrangements, trademark use, confidentiality, and term and termination.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a time-limited paid or free product pilot, covering evaluation-only use rights, pilot period, success criteria, and conversion to a full agreement.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Master agreement for professional services delivered under statements of work, covering deliverables, acceptance, fees and expenses, and ownership of work product.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level terms for a cloud service, defining target uptime, downtime exclusions, support response times, and service credits as the customer's remedy.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing on-premises or downloadable software, covering the license grant and restrictions, support, fees, IP ownership, and liability.
